payload.body: DONE + on PR #8 (commit 6ced534). frick schema generate now WRITES the 4 tracked native-client artifacts via frick-codegen, byte-identical to the retired pnpm generator (zero-byte git diff, pinned by a cli.rs byte-identity test). pnpm schema:generate is a thin cargo shim; verify:generated runs through it (exit 0, no drift) — frick-codegen is the canonical generator. Combined with native frick verify (FR-261 earlier) + frick schema export, this ticket is complete. generate-native-artifacts.ts deleted; schema signing (gitignored, key-gated) is a noted Rust-seam follow-up.
